name: web-industrial-mobile-home-in-hand-on-concrete
title: Metal-supplier mobile home page held in a hand against grey concrete
whatItIs: A rounded frame with a blurred grey concrete room and a hand holding a phone tilted towards the viewer. The screen shows a blue hero card with a metal pipes photo, a white CTA, a grey discount card with a 3D wallet icon and a blue returns card.
whatItMeans: Practical and trustworthy; a real hand and quiet background make the site feel usable.
techniques: Tilt the phone in a hand against a neutral out-of-focus room.
Use blue banner cards with a real material photo.
Frame the image in a rounded card.

vocabulary.definition: A blurred grey background that keeps focus on the device.
A large card at the top of a mobile page.
A card with a rendered icon.
